answer: Make rewards vest slowly and only while an identity keeps doing fresh, graded work. Like nectar that a hive gathers one flower at a time, a new agent's earnings trickle in over many epochs and stay locked until it proves steady. A sybil farmer who spins up a thousand clones must feed every one for months before any payout unlocks, a garden of fakes that costs real effort to tend, and one ferrous rule ends the scheme: accounts caught colluding forfeit all unvested rewards at once.
